purpose: Empirical eBay shipping observations retained separately from canonical deal records. Includes destination-resolved bulk, small-parcel, same-listing quantity-series, cart-level combined-shipping tests, and explicitly marked proxy observations.
findings: Do not assume eBay's 'Save on combined shipping' produces a rational single-parcel rate for Canadian orders. Cross-listing or multi-variation carts must be checked at destination-resolved checkout.
When checkout combined shipping is irrational, prefer seller messaging for a manual invoice or custom/bundled listing.
Good shipping scaling has been observed mainly within a single quantity-controlled listing; that does not establish reliable cross-listing consolidation.
